styleguide.title: Design reference
styleguide.subtitle: The design system in one page: the palette, the type scale, the controls and the academic patterns, rendered from the live tokens rather than copied from a sheet.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The palette is roles, not swatches. Indigo is the action, sky marks a citation and nothing else, emerald is done, amber is due soon, and rose is overdue or destructive. Every pair below is measured in both themes by the contrast test, so this list cannot drift from what renders.
palette.contrastNote: Text pairs clear 4.5:1 and borders, icons and the focus ring clear 3:1, in light and dark. The check runs in CI and fails the build on a miss.

swatch.borderStrong: a boundary that must be visible: input edges
swatch.primaryText: indigo as text: links, active nav
swatch.onPrimary: the label on a primary button

type.title: Type families
type.body: Build understanding, one concept at a time.
type.linkAfter: uses the body-text indigo, because the fill indigo is for surfaces that carry white text.
type.h4: A card title inside a card
type.label: Start review session
type.small: A secondary line inside a card
type.caption: Helper text under a field

citations.title: Citation marks
citations.description: The identity motif. A mark appears only next to something genuinely traceable, so it never implies grounding that is not there. A mark with a destination is a control; without one it is plain text.
citations.exampleLayer: Encapsulation adds a header at each layer
citations.exampleSeparately: . An outside result is marked separately
citations.interactive: The interactive form is shown above as a web citation, which has a real destination. A chunk citation becomes a button only when a caller passes a handler; with none it renders as text rather than a control that swallows clicks.

controls.title: Controls
controls.descriptionBefore: Appearance only. These are inert samples, not controls: they carry
controls.descriptionAfter: and are outside the tab order, because a button that does nothing is a defect rather than a demo (R-26). A real screen wires each one to its own action.
controls.inputHint: Give your session a clear, specific name.
controls.inputError: Enter a session name to continue.
controls.inputManaged: This name is managed by your course.
controls.targetsDescription: 44px is the shared default and the phone minimum; 32px with 8px gaps is the desktop floor. The field is 44px for the same reason: on a phone a control that is hard to hit is a control that gets missed.
controls.liveStates: Hover and focus are the stylesheet's live states on a real control: hover darkens the fill and the focus ring is drawn by :focus-visible.

course.title: Course cards
course.description: Six categorical hues. Each is a 4px marker plus a tinted chip plus an initial or icon, and never the only signal: two courses in the same colour are told apart by their names, and a course colour is not a status colour.
course.spec: Course code, name, then what is inside it. Context first, resources second.

chips.title: Due states
chips.description: A chip carries a state in words and the tone repeats it, so the state reads correctly in monochrome. A chip is a state, never an action: a control that changes what is on screen is a button.

dark.title: Dark core
dark.description: The dark theme is a designed theme, not a filter: the same tokens carry both, so a new surface works in dark mode without a variant. The primary action keeps the same indigo fill with white text.
dark.rule: Surface is not the background. Preserve the edge.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Space is structure. 8 groups tightly, 12 pads a control, 16 pads a card body, 24 separates related blocks and 32 separates sections. Nothing is spaced by eye.

radius.title: Corners
radius.description: Corners follow function. One pixel ruled borders, and elevation only for a layer that genuinely floats above the page.

a11y.title: Accessible by default
a11y.focusDescription: A 2px focus ring that is never removed without a replacement. The shared minimum is 44px, which clears the 32px desktop floor as well as the phone's.
a11y.contrastDescription: Body text clears 4.5:1 and control boundaries and large text clear 3:1, in both themes. Every semantic colour is accompanied by its word, so a state reads correctly in monochrome.
a11y.contrastSample: The primary fill on its label: {{ratio}}:1
a11y.labels: An error message says how to recover. Labels stay visible, because a placeholder is not a label.
a11y.symbolsDescription: 20px inside a control, 24px in navigation. One outline family at one stroke weight, drawn in the current colour so an icon cannot introduce a colour the contrast check has not measured.
